row: Hi I'm Laura Clinton of Equiflexion, I am an Equine Musculoskeletal Therapist qualified in Equine Sports Massage and Equine Musculoskeletal Manipulation Therapy. Here you will find videos for stretches and massage techniques that you can do at home in between visits from your qualified therapist to help keep your horse supple and free. These can only be performed on your own horse and do not substitute therapist or veterinary care.
